id: 12_Fundamentals of Working Safely in a Biological Safety Cabinet (BSC) Factors Affe
title: 看不见的气幕：生物安全柜的气流
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/12_Fundamentals of Working Safely in a Biological Safety Cabinet (BSC) Factors Affe.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/12_Fundamentals of Working Safely in a Biological Safety Cabinet (BSC) Factors Affe/src.py

points.K1: 气流一乱，人和样品都受害
points.K3: 正常气流：前窗吸入成气幕

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台生物安全柜旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a biological safety cabinet with its front window half open and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲生物安全柜里看不见的气流。
overlay: 看不见的气幕：生物安全柜的气流

shots.scene: 安全柜剖面图上画着蓝色气流箭头
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a biological safety cabinet with blue airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 气流就是它的防护墙。

shots.scene: 阿杰在生物安全柜里操作，柜内堆满盒子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student works at a biological safety cabinet crowded with boxes, racks and bottles.
shots.narration: 阿杰把东西全塞进安全柜，图方便。

shots.scene: 柜子旁边的门开着，有人匆匆走过
shots.prompt_en: Behind the young male student, the lab door swings open and the older man walks quickly past the cabinet.
shots.narration: 身后门一开，又有人匆匆走过。

shots.scene: 小研拿着一台空白外壳的发烟器走过来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over holding a small smoke generator with a blank casing.
shots.narration: 小研说：我们用烟来看看气流。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 看清气流，才知道哪些动作危险。

shots.section_title: 气流一乱，人和样品都受害
shots.scene: 安全柜开口处的气流箭头被打乱成漩涡
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a cabinet opening where straight airflow arrows break into swirls. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜的气流，很容易被打乱。
overlay: 气流一乱，人和样品都受害

shots.section_title: 气流一乱，人和样品都受害
shots.scene: 两个图标：操作者被小雾点包围；样品管被小点污染
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a person outline with tiny mist dots near the face, and a sample tube with contamination dots. No people.
shots.narration: 一乱，人可能暴露，样品可能污染。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套手持发烟器，在柜内放出白烟
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in a lab coat, goggles and gloves, releases a thin stream of white smoke inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 发烟器放出的白烟，能显示气流。

shots.scene: 白烟顺着气流移动
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a thin white smoke stream drifts and bends with the airflow above the work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 烟往哪走，空气就往哪走。

shots.section_title: 正常气流：前窗吸入成气幕
shots.scene: 白烟从前窗开口被吸进柜内
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: white smoke at the front opening is drawn smoothly into the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 正常时，空气从前窗开口吸进去，
overlay: 正常气流：前窗吸入成气幕

shots.section_title: 正常气流：前窗吸入成气幕
shots.scene: 白烟向下钻进前格栅
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the smoke turns downward and disappears into the front grille slots. No people.
shots.narration: 再向下钻进前格栅。

shots.section_title: 正常气流：前窗吸入成气幕
shots.scene: 前窗下沿画出一道蓝色气帘
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of the cabinet front with a blue curtain of air under the window edge separating inside and outside. No people.
shots.narration: 前窗加吸入的气流，形成一道气幕。

shots.section_title: 正常气流：前窗吸入成气幕
shots.scene: 柜内和室内空气各在气幕一侧
shots.prompt_en: The diagram shows inside air and room air on either side of the blue air curtain, not mixing. No people.
shots.narration: 把柜内空气和室内空气隔开。

shots.scene: 剖面图：顶部过滤器，干净空气向下吹
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram: air passes through a filter at the top of the cabinet and flows down as clean air. No people.
shots.narration: 柜顶的高效过滤器把空气滤干净，

shots.scene: 洁净气流向下吹过样品
shots.prompt_en: Clean downward arrows flow over sample tubes on the work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 从上往下吹，保护样品。

shots.scene: 气流到台面后一半向前、一半向后
shots.prompt_en: Downward arrows reach the work surface and split: half toward the front grille, half toward the back grille. No people.
shots.narration: 落到台面，一半往前，一半往后。

shots.scene: 平面图：安全柜紧挨着门口
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan with a biological safety cabinet placed right next to a lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 柜子放的位置，也会影响气流。

shots.scene: 门一开，柜内气流被吸向门外
shots.prompt_en: The door swings open and airflow arrows are pulled out of the cabinet toward the door. No people.
shots.narration: 离门太近，一开门气就被抽出来。

shots.scene: 天花板送风口正对安全柜吹风
shots.prompt_en: A ceiling air supply vent blows air straight down onto the cabinet opening, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 正对空调送风口，也会吹乱气幕。

shots.scene: 小研把前窗调到标记线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slides the front window to a marked line on the cabinet frame.
shots.narration: 前窗高度，是关键中的关键。

shots.scene: 柜体上的高度标记和空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a height mark on the cabinet frame next to a blank operation manual. No people.
shots.narration: 正确高度在说明书里，柜上也要标明。

shots.scene: 空白检测合格标签贴在柜上
shots.prompt_en: A blank certification tag with a green check stuck on the side of the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 检测时，就是按这个高度检测的。

shots.scene: 前窗被压得很低，开口处气流变急变乱
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of the front window pulled too low; arrows at the narrow opening become fast and swirling. No people.
shots.narration: 前窗太低，开口处风太急，

shots.scene: 柜内气流打转，样品旁出现污染点
shots.prompt_en: Swirling arrows inside the cabinet with contamination dots near the sample tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里起湍流，样品容易被污染。

shots.scene: 前窗被拉得太高，面板报警灯亮
shots.prompt_en: A cabinet with its front window raised too high; a red alarm light flashes on the control panel. No people.
shots.narration: 前窗太高，会报警。

shots.scene: 开口处吸力变弱，烟从前窗溢出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a wide opening with weak arrows; smoke leaks out of the cabinet toward the room. No people.
shots.narration: 吸力不够，柜内空气会漏出来。

shots.scene: 室内空气钻进柜内，混进下降气流
shots.prompt_en: Room air arrows slip into the cabinet and mix with the clean downward flow over the samples. No people.
shots.narration: 室内空气也会钻进去，污染样品。

shots.scene: 气幕画成一层薄薄的纱
shots.prompt_en: A diagram showing the air curtain at the opening as a thin, delicate veil. No people.
shots.narration: 就算高度正确，气幕也很薄弱。

shots.scene: 气幕旁出现一个风速小图标
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of the thin air curtain at the opening with a small wind speed gauge icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 开口处风速约每分钟100英尺，

shots.scene: 慢走的小人图标旁，一只手划破薄纱
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a slowly walking person next to a hand icon swiping through the thin veil and tearing it. No people.
shots.narration: 也就是每小时约1英里，很容易打乱。

shots.scene: 阿杰猛地把手臂抽出柜外，烟随手臂被带出
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pulls his arms out of the cabinet quickly; white smoke follows his sleeves out.
shots.narration: 手臂猛地抽出，会把柜内空气带出来。

shots.scene: 烟飘到操作者口鼻附近
shots.prompt_en: Smoke drifts up toward the young male student's face, near his nose and mouth.
shots.narration: 直接飘进操作者的呼吸带。

shots.scene: 阿杰再次快速抽手，烟被带出柜外
shots.prompt_en: The young male student again pulls his arms out quickly, and white smoke trails out of the cabinet behind his sleeves.
shots.narration: 抽手的方式不对，就会带出污染。

shots.scene: 老周从柜后走过时，气流被拉偏
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks closely behind the female graduate student; airflow arrows at the opening bend toward him.
shots.narration: 有人从背后快步走过，也会扯乱气幕。

shots.scene: 柜内堆满盒子、试剂瓶和手套盒
shots.prompt_en: A cabinet work surface crowded with boxes, reagent bottles and a glove box with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 常见错误：柜里东西堆太多。

shots.scene: 烟在杂物之间乱窜
shots.prompt_en: Smoke swirls chaotically between the crowded boxes and bottles. No people.
shots.narration: 气流被挡住，到处乱窜。

shots.scene: 纸张盖住前格栅，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A sheet of paper and a pad covering the front grille, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 前格栅、后格栅，都不能遮挡。

shots.scene: 柜内的火焰图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a burner flame inside a cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里不要用明火。

shots.scene: 火焰上方的热气流把下降气流冲乱
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of hot air rising from a flame and pushing the downward arrows into swirls. No people.
shots.narration: 火焰的热气往上冲，打乱气流。

shots.scene: 火焰与易燃物、着火的过滤器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a flame near a disinfectant bottle and a scorched filter with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 还会引起火灾，烤坏高效过滤器。

shots.scene: 王老师举着空白操作规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds up a blank standard operating procedure document.
shots.narration: 本片面向实验室人员，

shots.scene: 空白规程手册旁打一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure binder with a large green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不能代替你实验室自己的规程。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现气幕和过滤器图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of an air curtain and a filter.
shots.narration: 气幕护人，过滤气流护样品。

shots.scene: 门、送风口、前窗高度三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a door, a ceiling vent and a window height mark. No people.
shots.narration: 门口、送风口、前窗高度都影响气流。

shots.scene: 快速抽手、走动、堆物、明火四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons: fast arm movement arrows, a walking person, a crowded work surface, and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 抽手、走动、堆物、明火，都会打乱它。

shots.scene: 欣欣在安全柜旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy biological safety cabinet with its window at the marked height.
shots.narration: 护好气幕，就护好了自己，下次见！
